title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC ->CEP -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of decent quality captures a mixed show highlighted by an extended Sugaree guitar break and solid drumming, but the overall performance feels uneven.
ai_review.review: The SBD source is relatively clean for an early‑'80s tape, with a good mix though the bass and vocals can be a touch hot. Musically the concert is uneven – a short first set and a long break give way to a second set that some listeners found bland, yet Sugaree’s extended guitar solo and Stella’s strong intro/outro stand out, and the drummers provide the night’s saving grace.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average to below‑average (≈3/5) while recording quality is good (≈4/5); weighted combination yields ~3.3 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Relatively good mix for the period; bass and vocals a bit hot but clearer than many 81‑82 SBDs, no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set unusually short (six songs) followed by a long 45‑minute break; second set felt flat to some listeners despite a few strong moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for an extended, impressive guitar break on Sugaree and solid playing on Stella.
band_member_comments.Drums: Highlighted as the saving grace of an otherwise bland performance.
